source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of source code repositories (PDF 30).

blocks.text: Source code repositories woh platforms hain jahan developers apna code rakh (store), sambhal (manage) aur us mein hone wali tabdeeliyan track kar sakte hain. Repositories version control mein madad deti hain, yani kai developers baghair conflicts (takrao) ke ek hi project par kaam kar sakte hain. Repositories code ki tabdeeliyon ka hisab rakhti hain aur tamam tabdeeliyon ki history (pichhla record) mehfooz rakhti hain.

items: GitHub: open-source projects ke liye mashhoor platform.
Bitbucket: private aur public dono tarah ki repositories ke liye istemal hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Team project ke liye source code repository kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh code ka har version is history ke saath rakhti hai ke kis ne kya badla, aur version control ki wajah se kai developers ek hi code par ek saath kaam kar sakte hain baghair ek doosre ka kaam mitaye.

items: Repositories: code store, manage aur track karna; version control aur history; GitHub, Bitbucket.
